papers.title: CFEAR Radarodometry -- Conservative Filtering for Efficient and Accurate Radar Odometry

performance_data.conditions: Oxford Radar RobotCar 公开数据集，车顶 Navtech CTS350-X FMCW 雷达 4Hz、距离分辨率 4.38cm；空间交叉验证(SCV)设置；对比 Barnes Dual Cart 2.78%、Hong 3.11%、Cen 3.72%

TITLE produces the lowest per-sequence and mean SCV error with a translation and rotation error of 1.76% and 0.5 deg/100m, followed by Barnes Dual Cart [12] (2.78%), Hong odometry [14] (3.11%), and Cen [15] (3.72%).

performance_data.conditions: 同上，Oxford 城市基准 SCV 设置
performance_data.snippet: translation and rotation error of 1.76% and 0.5 deg/100m

performance_data.conditions: 纯 CPU 单线程实时运行，无 GPU
performance_data.snippet: running at 55Hz merely on a single laptop CPU thread

performance_data.conditions: 矿区(Kvarntorp mine)与 Volvo 试验场自采数据，大回环，无需重调参
performance_data.snippet: The accumulated error is roughly 15 m over a distance of 1235 m driving (1.2%). ... The maximum translation error is 15 m (1.3%) over the large loop.

conflicts.claim: 恶劣天气下雷达定位是否优于/可替代 LiDAR
conflicts.paper_a: Are We Ready for Radar to Replace Lidar in All-Weather Mapping and Localization? (arXiv 2203.10174)
conflicts.explanation: Boreas 实测显示雪暴中 LiDAR-only 定位仍最准、雷达只是'有竞争力+地图更小'；而 K-Radar/NTU4DRadLM/RadarSLAM 等在雾、烟、雨雪中给出雷达可用的证据。结论取决于天气类型与任务：中等降水对 LiDAR 的影响被高估，但浓烟/浓雾等遮蔽与低光照下 LiDAR/视觉确实退化，雷达优势最明显。对本项目：应把毫米波雷达定位为遮蔽/退化场景的补充与冗余，而非全天候全面替代。

conflicts.claim: CFEAR 雷达里程计误差数字（1.76% vs 0.61%）
conflicts.explanation: CFEAR 论文在 Oxford 基准自报 1.76%（KITTI 风格 100-800m 子序列），而 DRO 论文在 Boreas leaderboard 引用 CFEAR 0.61%。数据集、序列与评测协议不同，两数不矛盾；说明跨数据集不能直接比较百分比误差，本项目评测必须绑定数据集与指标定义。
